```{r}
time_data <- all_data |>
  group_by(background_group) |>
  summarize(
    mean = mean(error),
    sd = sd(error),
    n = n(),
    se = sd/sqrt(n)
  )





ggplot(time_data, aes(x=background_group, y=mean, fill=background_group)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= mean - se, ymax = mean + se)) +
  labs(title = "Reproduction Performance", x="Group Condition", y= "Hold Duration - Time on Screen") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color="black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5)
```
